text:
alina: kicking off Goldcrest LoRA onboarding. Customer finetune grafted onto redwood/rw-13b-lite. want quick sanity: fp16, int4, and a hybrid (attn int4, mlp fp16). dropping a 150-prompt smoke set focusing invoices, addresses, and refund flows. link: https://redwood.internal/evals/goldcrest/quickpack :sparkles:
michael: Thanks. Any tokenizer tweaks? Last time Goldcrest had a weird token-split on invoice numbers (#/dash).
alina: No tokenizer edits this round. LoRA was trained with r=4, alpha=16. But they used aggressive prompt concatenation which may create long sequences.
tomo: Noted. I'll watch K/V cache sizes and OOMs. Which quant scheme for int4?
alina: Try q4_1 and q4_0 both. config snippets: ```
# int4 baseline
--quant-mode int4
--quant-scheme q4_1
--per-channel-fallback none
--batch 8
--kvcache true

# hybrid
--quant-mode hybrid
--mlp-fp16 true
--attn-int4 true
--batch 4
```
nora: Quick datapoint from local fp16 smoke (100 prompts): embedding cosine drift vs base ~0.007, perplexity delta +1.2, but reranker score for top-1 answer dropped 0.03 in some refund cases.
michael: Can you paste an example where reranker drop matters? we need to know if it's semantics or formatting.
nora: Example: prompt includes invoice "INV-007-CC". base returns "refund scheduled" with cite; LoRA returns "refund may be processed" (softer). Top-k overlap 0.92 on that subset.
tomo: For int4 runs, I'll add the invoice regex-set to triggers so we can compute exact-match on invoice ids and numeric tokens.
alina: also watch embedding stability for downstream rerank. If embeddings shift, rerank ordering will change even if generation is fine. Consider freezing embedding layer to fp16 during quantization test.
michael: Good call. Also add the address canonicalization tests (Goldcrest requires preservation of unit numbers).

eval-bot: automated-eval started: running fp16 (n=150), int4(q4_0) (n=500), int4(q4_1) (n=500), hybrid (n=500). will post summary and artifacts.
tomo: Running int4(q4_0) now on rack-2, seed 123. Command: ```bash
redwood-eval run --model redwood/rw-13b-lite --lora goldcrest-v2 --quant q4_0 --eval-set goldcrest-smoke --seed 123 --out /tmp/gc-q40.json
```

nora: small manual check: in fp16 there are 2 examples where LoRA normalized address differently ("Apt 4B" -> "Unit 4"), might be acceptable but flagging.
michael: Please capture those as behavior diffs. we should decide which normalizations are acceptable vs breaking.
alina: eval-bot reported early summary: fp16: ok (exact-match 96% on invoice ids), int4 q4_0: fail (invoice digits jitter, 28 flagged), int4 q4_1: warn (12 flagged), hybrid: pass-ish (5 flagged, mostly address normalization). full: https://redwood.internal/evals/goldcrest/report/1736900000
tomo: I pulled the int4 q4_0 logs: most failures are single-digit flips in invoice numbers (e.g., 210 -> 219). looks like quant rounding on final projection.
michael: Can we try keeping the final lm_head in fp16 and quantize rest? maybe cheap fix.
alina: yep try mlp+lm_head fp16, attn int4. If that stabilizes numeric tokens it's worth the latency hit.
nora: hybrid run with lm_head fp16 now queued. also prepping a small repair set of ~50 examples with explicit invoice/date tokens to run as gating set.
eval-bot: artifact uploaded: /artifacts/goldcrest/q4_1-run-1736900300.json
tomo: hybrid+lm_head-fp16 run finished: delta in exact-match down to 2/500, top-k overlap 0.988, latency +8% vs pure int4.
michael: That's promising. For the demo to the customer, propose: route invoice-confirmation API to fp16 or hybrid-lmhead-fp16 until we reach >99.5% exact-match. keep chat fallback on int4 for lower-cost.
alina: Agreed. next actions: tomo to run hybrid across 3 seeds and upload artifacts, nora to assemble repair prompts and small fine-tune candidate, michael to draft runbook for per-route overrides + metric gating. I'll summarize for PM and sales.
michael: tagging @sales-eng in next message; will coordinate pricing note for hybrid route.
nora: one last note: we saw a tiny drop in embedding similarity for addresses under q4_0. if customer uses embeddings for matching, warn them.
alina: noted. closing thread when final artifacts uploaded. thanks all :white_check_mark:
